title: The 8 Levels of Gym Fitness Lies
house: A bustling metropolitan city populated by produce people, featuring neon-lit fitness clubs, juice bars, and rain-slicked asphalt streets.
catchphrase: The number on your forehead never lies.
links: The glowing digital badge on the barista's forehead flickers whenever someone orders a pre-workout shake.
A fitness influencer with a flashing 99% badge is spotted arguing near the subway turnstile.
The rattling vending machine outside the gym accepts discarded protein powder scoops as tokens.

levels.open_loop: Why did the gym receptionist immediately cancel my membership card after seeing my glowing badge?

gegenspieler.tat: Laughs loudly at the new member's zero-experience badge and trips him near the dumbbell rack.

levels.name: Sam, 22, Couch Potato
levels.story: The 8 levels of gym fitness lies. Level 1. 2,000 percent fat burning? Who let this absolute trash bag into the studio anyway? Maybe he can wipe down the dumbbells for actual athletes after I humiliate him. Level 1: 0% fitness level – and I told everyone I bench press three hundred pounds to impress the local crowd. I stood inside IronPulse Gym wearing brand-new neon sneakers that still had the price tag tucked inside, completely terrified of everyone around me. My bright green broccoli head was sweating profusely before I even touched a single piece of equipment. I hesitantly grabbed a single two-pound pink plastic weight, my arms shaking like a wet leaf in a violent hurricane while everyone watched and pointed. You call that lifting? You look like you break a sweat just opening a bag of potato chips, you pathetic loser! He snatched the two-pound weight right out of my trembling hand with sheer disgust and tossed it across the hard rubber floor. Look at him, he doesn't even know what a protein shaker is, let alone how to use one! Real gym rats don't belong here with the absolute weak, and you are getting kicked out immediately. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Clementine, 25, Yoga Beginner
levels.story: The 8 levels of gym fitness lies. Level 2. I knew she was a complete fraud the second she walked in with those fake designer labels, and I was going to make sure everyone in the room saw her fall. Level 2: 12% fitness level – and I claimed I taught advanced hot yoga in Tulum to all my friends. I walked into ZenBox Studio wearing four layers of designer athleisure and holding a crystal-infused water bottle while trying to look like a pro. My bright orange citrus peel skin glowed under the dim amber studio lights as I nervously rolled out my mat upside down. You call that a warrior pose? Your balance looks like a melting snowman on roller skates, absolutely pathetic! The entire class turned their heads and laughed loudly while my knees shook so hard they clicked like castanets in an earthquake. She's going to fall over any second now, watch out for the disaster! People like you shouldn't even own a yoga mat, let alone step foot in here. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Barry, 28, Smoothie Enthusiast
levels.story: The 8 levels of gym fitness lies. Level 3. Spike stood there with his massive, unearned ego, radiating an unbearable arrogance that made my blood boil instantly. He looked down at me like I was absolute garbage beneath his expensive lifting shoes. Level 3: 28% fitness level – and I swore my daily smoothie cost more than my entire apartment rent. I leaned against the counter at Juice & Jolt holding a massive shaker bottle filled with questionable gray sludge. My long, curved yellow banana body was wearing a ripped string tank top to desperately show off nonexistent muscles. Is that your homemade protein sludge? It smells like a wet gym sock left in a dumpster for three weeks, you absolute joke! The barista and two regular gym members burst into loud, cruel mocking laughter that echoed off the stainless steel counters. Gorilla extract? More like expired pancake batter mixed with tap water! Keep lying about your pathetic gains and I'll cancel your membership permanently so you can never return. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Ruby, 24, Treadmill Sprinter
levels.story: The 8 levels of gym fitness lies. Level 4. Can anyone really survive a 99.9 percent heart rate spike without completely collapsing on live camera? Level 4: 42% fitness level – and I proudly bragged I could easily run a full marathon in under three hours. I pounded the rubber belt of treadmill number twelve at MetroGym, my bright red strawberry skin dripping with absolute sweat. I frantically pushed the speed button up to twelve miles per hour, my little legs spinning like out-of-control ceiling fan blades. You call that pacing? You look like a cheap wind-up toy about to run out of batteries completely! My chest burned like swallowed fire, and my lungs felt like they were collapsing into tiny wet paper bags while everyone stared. She's going to fly right off the back of the belt and crash! Hold your phones up right now! Sprinters like you don't survive past mile two without a stretcher. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Kira, 29, Pilates Instructor
levels.story: The 8 levels of gym fitness lies. Level 5. That arrogant dragonfruit thought she could treat everyone like trash forever, but I remembered how she humiliated me in Level 2 and I was ready for brutal revenge. Level 5: 58% fitness level – and I pretended I owned three luxury boutique fitness studios downtown to maintain my fake status. I stood at the front of the Pilates reformer studio wearing custom gold-threaded leggings that cost a fortune. My magenta dragonfruit scaled skin caught every glimmer of the overhead studio chandelier while I put on a fake smile. That same nervous Orange woman with the 12% badge whom I bullied earlier marched right into my advanced class and dropped her ring on purpose. You don't even know how to spell reformer, let alone operate one. Get out of my studio right now! Did she really just kick a beginner out of her own class after being exposed? Your studio lease bounced this morning and you are completely evicted! You'll see that in Level 6.

levels.name: Julian, 29, Marathon Runner
levels.story: The 8 levels of gym fitness lies. Level 6. Barry strutted over with an unbearable arrogance, flashing a toxic grin that made every single nerve in my body scream in pure fury. He knew my knee was completely destroyed, and he loved rubbing it in. Level 6: 65% fitness level – and I desperately hid my completely torn knee ligament just to qualify for the city elite heat. I laced up my expensive carbon-plated racing shoes on the concrete bleachers at Central Stadium while wincing in agony. My dark green cucumber skin was heavily taped up with physical therapy straps and thick medical wrap. Nice tape job, old man, looks like your cartilage gave up three years ago and you belong in a nursing home! Is he actually running on a torn ligament? That's completely insane and suicidal! Your doctor just called the race director ten minutes ago to ban you. You'll see that in Level 7.

levels.name: Spike, 33, Heavy Lifter
levels.story: The 8 levels of gym fitness lies. Level 7. The 500-pound weight on the bar looked terrifyingly real, but behind the flashing lights and roaring crowd, his bank account was completely wiped out by bankruptcy. Level 7: 74% fitness level – and I proudly claimed I could bench press five hundred pounds using only one arm like a beast. I stood in front of the heavy power rack at IronCore Barbell Club, my golden pineapple crown gleaming under the lights. I loaded four heavy iron plates onto each side of the barbell, grunting loudly for maximum effect while my muscles burned. A tiny, nervous Broccoli kid with a 0% badge walked past my station holding a pink two-pound dumbbell and smirked at me. Touch that weight and your little arms will snap clean off your shoulders like dry twigs, you worthless nobody! Look at him posing with weights he can't even unrack without crying! Your gym membership payment bounced for the third time this month, and you're broke! You'll see that in Level 8.

levels.name: Thorpe, 35, Gym Owner
levels.story: The 8 levels of gym fitness lies. Level 8. Every single lie, every fake badge, and every pathetic scam across this entire city finally ended right here in my office. Level 8: 99% fitness level – and I owned every single lying fitness fraud who ever stepped foot in this town. I sat behind my massive mahogany desk inside the executive office of IronPulse Gym, watching the city burn. My polished brown Coconut shell reflected the glowing neon city skyline outside the rain-slicked window. A disgraced Pineapple lifter with a 74% badge stood trembling in front of my door holding his final eviction notice. You thought you could run my gym without paying your dues, didn't you, Spike? Game over! He owns all eight locations across the entire downtown district and all your assets! The number on your forehead doesn't ever measure your workout; it measures your accumulated debt. And mine is paid in full forever. What theme should we do next? Let us know in the comments!
